name: acm-monorepo
description: ACM – Components & Equipment Management System Monorepo

scripts.dev:all: npm run dev --workspace=@acm/api & npm run dev --workspace=@acm/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@acm/shared && npm run build --workspace=@acm/api && npm run build --workspace=@acm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace=@acm/shared && npm run test:unit --workspace=@acm/api && npm run test:unit --workspace=@acm/web
scripts.ci: npm run prisma:validate && npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:unit

author: ACM Engineering Team
